name: Festool DOMINO tenon, beech, 4 × 20 mm

sources.title: Festool DOMINO, beech D 4x20/450 BU (Festool)
sources.note: Dimensions 4 x 20 x 16.6 mm (thickness, length, width), 450 in a pack, order number 495661, for the DF 500

sources.title: The DOMINO system user manual, AU edition, 2016 (Festool)
sources.note: Page 17: on the DF 500 the narrowest hole width matches the tenon, and the two wider settings give 6 and 10 mm of play. Page 19: routing depth is usually half the tenon's length; the depth stops are 12, 15, 20, 25 and 28 mm, only 12, 15 and 20 with the 5 mm cutter, and the 4 x 20 tenon's cutter is 10 mm short, so it cuts 10 mm on the 20 mm stop. Page 86: DF 500 cutters are 4, 5, 6, 8 and 10 mm. Pages 88 and 92: cutter and beech tenon order numbers

sources.title: Beech DOMINO tenons D 4x20/450 BU (Festool USA)
sources.note: The tenon is about 2 mm shorter than its nominal length, which leaves room for glue in the mortises

mounting: Glued into a matching pair of mortises, one in each part, cut with a Festool DOMINO DF 500 joiner and its D 4-NL 11 HW-DF 500 cutter (495663). About half its length goes into each part.
notes: Sold as 4 x 20: thickness by length. The width, 16.6 mm, runs along the joint, and the mortise is cut that wide on the joiner's tightest setting, or 6 or 10 mm wider for play. Each mortise is 10 mm deep, on the 20 mm stop, which cuts 10 mm with this shortened cutter. The model is a plain box the tenon's size, without its rounded edges and glue grooves. The manual lists this size in beech only, 450 to a pack.
